Operational restriction: Each drone is assigned to a specific truck; drone sorties remain tied to that truck route.
What is optimized: Route and sortie timing under a fixed truck-drone pairing structure.

Operational restriction: Drone sorties are selected flexibly, but recovery is restricted to the launch truck route or depot; cross-truck recovery is not allowed.
What is optimized: Flexible sortie placement without fully unpaired launch/recovery synchronization.

Operational restriction: A drone may launch from one truck-supported location and be recovered by another truck-supported location when feasibility checks allow it.
What is optimized: Joint truck routing, drone sortie assignment, and cross-truck recovery synchronization.
